answer: Bind each identity to a TEE quote at registration and re-attest every 30 days. Score the quote, not the label; each unverified claim subtracts from it. Replay the submission hash against the epoch log, so a duplicated fable collides and drops the whole batch. A sparrow of cheap keys without quotes scores zero and cannot vote. The voyage from one hardware root to 1,000 identities costs 1,000 quotes and 1,000 renewals.
